candidate_facts.text: The United States intervened in the Korean War to prevent the spread of communism.
The United States' intervention in the Korean War aligned with the Cold War policy of containment.
The North Korean invasion of South Korea on June 25, 1950, directly triggered U.S. military involvement.
The United States committed troops to defend South Korea following the North Korean invasion.
President Truman authorized General Douglas MacArthur to provide air and naval support to South Korea.
The United States led a United Nations coalition to defend South Korea after the North Korean invasion.
UN Security Council Resolution 83 authorized military assistance to South Korea.

sub_narrative: "What motivated US involvement in the Korean War?"
